transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... I suppose I'm just having some trouble lately. I keep... dodging things. Anything that reminds me of my old job, really. Big office buildings, security talks... even networking events if they're near the old work sites. I just stay away. 

And if people start asking about... you know, the day it happened... I just make some excuse and get out of there. So... I guess that's why I'm here.
Have you been having unwanted or intrusive memories of what happened at your old job, or do you ever feel like you're reliving the event?

Yes... sometimes. It just happens. I'll be doing something completely normal, like washing dishes, or maybe just driving past a warehouse gate, and... it's just there again. 

It's very sharp. I can... I can hear people's voices. The panic. My chest gets tight, almost like I'm standing right back in it. But... yes, I guess that happens sometimes.
Have you found yourself avoiding certain activities, situations, or even people because they bring back distressing memories or make you feel anxious?

I... I thought I mentioned that earlier. But yes. I just... I stay away from things. Anything that reminds me of it. Office buildings... security talks. Even networking events if they're near the old sites. I just don't go. And if someone brings up that day... I just leave. I make an excuse and leave. It's just easier that way.
Since the event, have you noticed that you often feel afraid, angry, or guilty, or that you're in a negative mood most of the time?
I don't think so. I mean... I wouldn't say I feel like that most of the time. I'm just... trying to get by, really.
Since the event, have you noticed that you often feel afraid, angry, or guilty, or that you're in a negative mood most of the time?
I... didn't you just ask me that? Like I said, no. I don't really feel like that. I'm not angry or anything. I'm just... trying to keep my head down and get through the week.
Since the event, have you noticed any changes in the way you think about yourself, other people, or the world — like believing you're unsafe, others are untrustworthy, or that the future looks bleak?

I suppose... yes. It's hard not to. I just... I catch myself thinking that nobody is really safe to trust. I mean, even someone you managed, someone you tried to help... they can just turn around and become dangerous. So... yeah, I guess my thoughts have changed a bit.
